Let  
\[
\delta_n=\gcd(n^3+1,3n^2+3n+1).
\]
Let \(d=\delta_n\). Then
\[
d\mid 3(n^3+1)-n(3n^2+3n+1)= -3n^2-n+3,
\]
so
\[
d\mid 3n^2+n-3.
\]
Thus
\[
d\mid (3n^2+3n+1)-(3n^2+n-3)=2(n+2).
\]
Since \(3n^2+3n+1\) is always odd, \(d\) is odd, so \(d\mid n+2\). Hence \(n\equiv -2\pmod d\), giving
\[
3n^2+3n+1 \equiv 12-6+1=7 \pmod d.
\]
So \(d\mid 7\). Therefore \(\delta_n\le 7\).

This value is achieved at \(n=5\):
\[
\gcd(1+6^3,1+5^3)=\gcd(217,126)=7.
\]

\[
\boxed{7}
\]
